Spearman’s correlation analysis between rumen Prevotella and phenological indicators, differential metabolites in rumen and plasma pathways of Hu sheep in LS and CON groups

Spearman’s correlation analysis between rumen Prevotella and phenological indicators, differential metabolites in rumen and plasma pathways of Hu sheep in LS and CON groups. Red and blue lines represent positive and negative correlations, respectively. The corresponding r- and P-value between two nodes are provided in Table S6. CON, chrysanthemum stalks replaced no peanut vines; LS, chrysanthemum stalks replaced 7.88% of peanut vines. BW = body weight; ADG = average daily gain; DMI = dry matter intake; DMD = dry matter digestibility; OMD = organic matter digestibility; CPD = crude protein digestibility; NDFD = neutral detergent fiber digestibility; ADFD = acid detergent fiber digestibility; VFA = volatile fatty acid; NH3–N = ammonia-nitrogen; MCP = microbial crude protein; ALP = alkaline phosphatase; ALT = alanine aminotransferase; AST = aspartate aminotransferase; T-AOC = total antioxidant capacity; IgA = immunoglobulin A; IgM = immunoglobulin M; TNF-α = tumor necrosis factor-α; IFN-γ = interferon-γ
